name: APG-68-class radar, as DCS's F-16 tracked in practice
description: APG-68 with DCS's numbers (SIM_REV 22): the player's F-16 in DCS first held a buggable TWS track at 35-72 km against the AI's F-16 (22 fights, 20-22 October), and took 15-20 s with the target in the scan to build it. Range randomised ±15% per episode as APG-68.

sources.MAX_RANGE: DCS: first bugged track 35-72 km (median about 47) in 20-22 October fights; 55 km ±15% spans 47-63
sources.REF_RCS_M2: set equal to the F-16's RCS, so F-16 targets are detected at MAX_RANGE
sources.ACQUIRE_S: DCS: 15-20 s from the target entering the TWS A6 4B scan to a buggable track (stick logs, 22 October)
